category_definitions.multiple_candidate_records: a non-placeholder source_record_id occurs in more than one frozen sample row; this is a candidate-review signal, not a finding that records should be merged
category_definitions.potential_conflicting_evidence: a conflict-detection probe: realization_evidence_grade is X, or physical_work_started_dataset is yes while status is cancelled/canceled/inactive; the category does not assert that conflicting evidence has been found
